conceptual_change: Transitioning from volume/liquidity metrics to a spatial efficiency ratio within the SMC framework; evaluating the distance from VWAP relative to absolute volume to identify exhaustion points or structural breaks (Liquidity Voids) following high-volatility price expansions.
